provenance.sample: bounded sequence, not the whole history: counts, rates and injectability hold for these sessions only
provenance.builder: local/facts.mjs commandDigest, one digest per client session (copies of one transcript merged by call id)
provenance.selection: for each fact, its sessions in time order from proposal until it is active with at least 4 exercised sessions (all of them if it never is); up to 2 newest sessions per must-not-produce signal; the 2 newest sessions of at least 5 commands that all succeeded; browser-mcp: every session
provenance.approved: owner, 2026-11-11: these repos and facts, and an empty edited-file set counts as disjoint
provenance.expectations: strict P1 rules: local/facts-detect.mjs detect and facts-client.mjs reportBody over digests.jsonl in order, with the server lifecycle of the facts wire contract as corrected on 2026-11-11 (chain keeps only attested-disjoint prior sessions, then appends; 3 activates; 2 consecutive contradictions retire a candidate or active fact)
provenance.superseded: the P0 expectations (2026-11-11) came from a broader replay with no 5-command repair window and a lenient success check; they are replaced, not cherry-picked
provenance.owner_examples: the owner-approved facts are examples, not an allowlist: every fact these sessions qualify is listed
provenance.whole_local_history: counts from scratch digests of every local session, built before the final scrub fix; for context only, not reproducible from this fixture

rules.repair: a failed command, then within 5 commands the same program and head with an added environment change and a proven success (single command or && chain, recorded exit 0, not cut)
rules.reuse: a known command_repair fact is confirmed again when its fix runs with a proven success
rules.contradiction: a proven success of exactly what the fact says fails; it wins over a confirmation in the same session
rules.activation: 3 sessions in the device chain, each attested disjoint from the earlier ones; an empty edited-file set is disjoint; no local history means no attestation
rules.exercised: a session whose triggers include the fact's trigger, or that fired it
rules.injectable: active, at least 4 exercised and fired * 5 >= exercised * 2
